description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to Land Parcels Delgamuwa, Kuruvita D/S Division, Ratnapura  District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title determination, cadastral maps, and property ownership claims across multiple districts (Rathnapura, Kurunegala, Gampaha), which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
